CORSRule.description_en:
The container for a CORS rule.

Each bucket allows a maximum of 10 CORS rules. The maximum size of the uploaded XML document is 16 KB
CORSRule.description_zh:
CORS规则的容器。

每个Bucket最多允许10条CORS规则。上传的XML文档最大允许16 KB

AllowedHeader.description_en:
Specifies whether the headers specified in Access-Control-Request-Headers in an OPTIONS preflight request are allowed. Each header specified in Access-Control-Request-Headers must have a corresponding entry in AllowedHeader.

Only one asterisk (*) wildcard character is allowed
AllowedHeader.description_zh:
控制OPTIONS预取指令Access-Control-Request-Headers中指定的Header是否被允许。在Access-Control-Request-Headers中指定的每个Header都必须在AllowedHeader中有对应的项。

仅允许使用一个星号（*）通配符
AllowedHeader.title: description

items.description_en:

AllowedOrigin.description_en: The allowed origins for cross-origin requests
AllowedOrigin.description_zh: 指定允许的跨域请求来源

items.description_en:
指定允许的跨域请求来源。

OSS允许使用多个元素来指定多个允许的来源。多个元素之间用英文逗号(,)分隔。

OSS仅允许使用一个星号（\）通配符。如果指定为星号（\），则表示允许所有来源的跨域请求

ExposeHeader.description_en:
The response headers that users are allowed to access from an application, such as a JavaScript XMLHttpRequest object.

The asterisk (*) wildcard character is not allowed

不允许使用星号（*）通配符

MaxAgeSeconds.description_en:
The cache duration for the browser to cache the response of an OPTIONS preflight request for a specific resource. Unit: seconds.

Only one MaxAgeSeconds is allowed per CORS rule
MaxAgeSeconds.description_zh:
指定浏览器对特定资源的预取（OPTIONS）请求返回结果的缓存时间。单位为秒。

单条CORS规则仅允许一个MaxAgeSeconds
MaxAgeSeconds.title: description

name: GetBucketCors

ResponseVary.description_en:
Indicates whether the Vary: Origin header is returned.

true: The Vary: Origin header is returned regardless of whether the request is a cross-origin request or whether the cross-origin request succeeds.

false: The Vary: Origin header is not returned in any case
ResponseVary.description_zh:
是否返回Vary: Origin头。

true：不管发送的是否是跨域请求或跨域请求是否成功，均会返回Vary: Origin头。

false：任何情况下均不返回Vary: Origin头
